items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a system of sheaves indexed by an ordinal of sufficiently large cofinality, the canonical map from the colimit of the values to the value of the colimit is bijective at every object (statement lines 3920-3933). The proof is a complete argument: the two sides are identified as the value of a presheaf colimit and its sheafification (proof lines 3936-3941); for a covering whose index is smaller than the cofinality, sections over the covering and their compatibilities are represented at a single stage by the cofinality assumption (proof lines 3942-3964); and the presheaf colimit is thereby seen to satisfy the sheaf condition, so that sheafification leaves its values unchanged (proof lines 3965-3969). The non-formal content is the stagewise representation of sections and compatibilities. The claim is H2: a written-out argument with the cofinality input used explicitly.
